lf-swipe-deck.description: One rapid architecture-backlog Ask. Put it inside lf-ask with a heading that states the question. Cards begin in the `unseen` pile; the reader sends each active card to the `pass` or `keep` pile with the labeled buttons, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight, or a horizontal pointer swipe. Intermediate classifications reach the agent as absolute `swipe` actions; the final one is a `finish` action with the same position record, and that verb completes the Ask only when its recorded move leaves `unseen` empty. Children are exactly one lf-swipe-pile for each verdict. Re-emit the authored starting order unchanged on later versions: recorded classifications carry forward by card id. Rewriting an intermediate classified card needs `restated` on that card; invalidating a completed deck needs `restated` on the deck.

lf-swipe-pile.description: One semantic pile in a swipe deck. Supply exactly one pile for each `verdict`: `unseen` is the ordered queue, `pass` is out of scope, and `keep` is retained for follow-up. Children are lf-swipe-card elements only; cards are reparented here as recorded position state, so the verdict attribute is the classification and no card-level status is needed.

lf-swipe-card.description: One concise technical proposal in a swipe deck. Lead with a <strong> title and follow with enough prose to classify it without leaving the deck. Its id identifies it in classification details and preserves its verdict across page versions. Rewriting a classified proposal needs `restated` on this card (see `$restated` in the default registry).
